content: B2B wholesale OMS commonly include: unified order tracking dashboard, automation of approvals/payment verification/invoicing, flexible/tiered/contract pricing per account, multi-channel order capture (rep portals, buyer self-service, marketplaces), ERP/CRM/accounting/shipping integrations, quote-to-order conversion, credit checks and approval routing, multi-node fulfillment with real-time inventory visibility, and sales/inventory analytics.
